name: io.github.chrischall/booli-mcp
description: Booli.se real estate for Claude: search listings, sold prices, areas & market stats

environmentVariables.name: BOOLI_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Selects the path: auto (default — direct fetch first, browser-bridge fallback when walled), fetchproxy (always the bridge), or direct.

environmentVariables.name: BOOLI_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Override the fetchproxy WebSocket port (the fleet shares 37149).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bridge bind interface, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the long-term bridge identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller.
